name: Anterior Superior Iliac Spine Avulsion Fracture
tags: anterior superior iliac spine avulsion fracture
definition: Adolescent apophyseal avulsion fracture of the ASIS, usually caused by sudden forceful sartorius or tensor fasciae latae contraction.

investigations.principle: Pelvic radiographs usually diagnose; CT/MRI is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Large displacement or persistent symptoms may need fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni-bhagna phenotype may be documented after modern fracture assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Adolescent apophyseal avulsion fracture of the ASIS, usually caused by sudden forceful sartorius or tensor fasciae latae contraction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
